notes.title: [State of The Game] Upcoming Patch v0.0.8
notes.content:
Greetings Conquerors!

Currently Conquest of Gerazania is undergoing a lot of revision just as most games during Early Access change frequently. The biggest change that is being implemented is the campaign feature; it will no longer be an episodic story and will instead allow players to select a race and faction to represent while conquering Gerazania. The campaign will feature a battle map where you will be able to view all of Gerazania by regions and territories, ultimately allowing you to make strategic decisions during your attempt to conquer Gerazania. More specific details will be released once this update is ready to be released!

The store page will undergo some revision as well; I will be implementing new/different images and uploading a game play video so that players can get a better understanding of the game and it's mechanics and concepts.

Finally, I hope that everyone had an excellent Christmas and enjoyed the holidays with their families and loved ones, see you on the battlefield!

notes.title: Hotfix v0.0.7.1
notes.content:
Thank you again for everyone who has purchased the game! I am releasing a minor hotfix for some minor issues which are displayed below.

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*]Created an exit game button on the main menu so that players can easily quit the application.
[/list]
[b]Units - [i]Practice Mode[/i][/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where Elite Knight could be selected.
[*]Fixed an issue where Legendary Elite Fae Sorceress could be selected.
[/list]

I am still working on finishing the first episode for the story mode and I am hoping to release it very soon! Thank you again for your patience!

notes.title: Launch is coming!
notes.content:
With less than 24 hours remaining for Conquest of Gerazania to be released for Early Access, I can say that I am very excited! Firstly, I would like to thank each and every one of you who support this game by either purchasing, making videos, or providing constructive criticism, so that this game could possibly become the gem I believe it as the potential to be! For those of you who purchase the game you will notice that currently the available modes are 'Practice' and 'Hotseat'! Do not fret, I am working very diligently on releasing the first episode of 'Play' mode; one of the main reasons that it has taken a little longer than expected is because I am trying to make the story mode as immersive as I possibly can. I want to tug at your heart strings, I want to play your emotions like the Devil plays His fiddle, so please bear with me as I work to get the first episode released! I am also planning for 'Onslaught' mode to come out soon. Here, you will be able to fight against waves of enemies with randomized units for a top spot in the leaderboards! 

Again, I want to thank those of you personally who are supporting this game, I hope you enjoy!
